rule: Manifest v2 games on the held-out maps (Autarky, Maze, Trauma), post-m2, ranked, in_scope (v2 flag), with at least one side from the ten teacher teams of teachers_v1, minus every game whose series appears in teachers_v1 (the R2 training/development input, which contains dev120). Tanaka P-5 review: 497 games / 374 series -> 115 / 85.
coverage_method: tools/learn/coverage.py: engine re-run with the server seed + template beds, answered by the replay's own actions; only a reproduced flag, turn count and teacher-process count are written. No action, label, outcome or feature value was computed or stored. Labels of these games remain unread.

proposed_rules.note: 81 of the 115 games lie in series consumed by P-2 (value model on non-held-out maps); not an R2 input, listed for the record
